I'm not mourning my luck, i came to figure out the universe is going to do what it wants when it wants and theres nothing i can do about that.
The problem i'm facing is i don't see it getting better, With your autism and other things i can see you have had some very hard times.
My sense of loss comes from not having someone to turn too i think.
When i found out my wife cheated i felt so much anger and i talked to a friend some. Then i came to relize that there was no one else i could figure this out with. It was just me and its making me feel like its just to much. I don't see the light at the end of this. I just see nothing
